title: GTA 6 Release Date Speculations Intensify
description: Rumors about the release date of the highly anticipated video game Grand Theft Auto 6 are gaining traction, with insiders suggesting a new trailer could arrive within two weeks.

sections.heading: Insider Predictions
paragraphs: According to TweakTown, an insider expects the third GTA 6 trailer to arrive within two weeks, fueling further speculation about the game's release.

sections.heading: Current Knowledge
paragraphs: Kotaku has compiled everything currently known about Grand Theft Auto 6, though an official release date has not been confirmed by the game's developers.

sections.heading: Anti-Leak Measures
paragraphs: Notebookcheck reports that Take-Two, the game's publisher, is targeting fake AI-generated leaks to prevent misinformation about GTA 6 from spreading.

faq.q: What is the current status of GTA 6?
faq.a: While there are many rumors and speculations, no official release date for GTA 6 has been confirmed by the developers.

faq.q: Is a new trailer expected soon?
faq.a: TweakTown cites an insider who expects the third GTA 6 trailer to arrive within two weeks, but this has not been officially announced.
